home.bio: I'm a product-focused software engineer who builds scalable, data-driven systems that support real teams in production — relational data models, APIs, and background processing alongside React and TypeScript frontends. A background in UX/UI design means I think through user experience, data integrity, and system reliability together rather than in isolation, and I'm most motivated by mission-driven work — lately, tools that support sustainability and waste reduction. Originally from Portland, Oregon, now based in Freiburg, Germany. In my free time you'll find me traveling, doing house projects, and building apps to improve my day-to-day life.
